name: Bakumatsu Midarezaki
source: You're an ordinary high school student with a boring life, but after suffering a traffic accident you find yourself in the Bakumatsu era! Ryoma Sakamoto, Shintaro Nakaoka, Soji Okita and Toshizo Hijikata will all cross paths with you, and what will happen once you meet...?
translation: 你是个过着无聊生活的普通高中生，却在一场交通事故后，发现自己来到了幕末时代！坂本龙马、中冈慎太郎、冲田总司与土方岁三，都将与你产生交集。相遇之后，又会发生怎样的故事呢……？
